description_expanded:
Seagrove, just minutes from Seaside

212 steps to San Juan Public Beach Access

Private pool!

4 bikes

Green Egg charcoal grill

4-star restaurants

Fun, yummy eateries

Shops

91 San Juan by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 New in 2018, 91 San Juan is a two-story home with 4 bedrooms, 3.5 baths, 4 balconies, and sleeps 10. It’s in the heart of Seagrove Beach, just 300 yards to beach access and 1.25 miles to Seaside. Outside, the private pool is very inviting. And along with a large Green Egg grill, this is definitely a vacation highlight, an excellent area for the entire family to unwind. Overlooking the pool area is the screened-in back porch. This wonderful space, with a hanging day bed, can be accessed through the French doors in the open living area. The interior is bright and charming, with high-end finishes, hickory wood floors throughout, 10' ceilings on both levels, and quartz countertops in the baths and in the gourmet kitchen, which includes commercial-grade KitchenAid appliances.

The spacious dining area comfortably seats 8. Nearby, a primary suite, king, has a private bath with large walk-in shower and dual vanity. The second floor hosts another primary suite, king, with a private bath, a large walk-in shower, and large soaking tub. This suite also has a private balcony. A third guest room, king, has a private balcony overlooking the pool and a shared full bath. The fourth guest room has two twin bunk beds (4 twin beds) and a shared bathroom. Welcome! Our dedicated team at Oversee 30A, a local company, is committed to ensuring your stay is nothing short of exceptional. We strive for perfection and are just a stone's throw away should you require any assistance. Reach out to us anytime, seven days a week, with the added peace of a 24/7 emergency line. Overview: - 212 steps (.1 mile) to the beach (San Juan Access) - 4 bedrooms, 3.5 baths - 2385 sq ft - Gas grill - Wi-Fi - 4 bikes included - Green egg/charcoal grill - Private pool (can be heated seasonally for an additional $55.00 per day, contact Oversee for details) Overnight: - King in 1st floor primary bedroom; private bath; TV (49”) - King in 2nd floor primary; walk-in shower, soaking tub; private balcony; TV - King in 2nd floor guest room; shared bath with walk-in shower; TV - 2 twin bunks in 2nd floor guest room; shared bath; TV Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
